article_leigh.materials:
Frame: solid pine, poplar engineered wood, nylon webbing, steel sleeper mechanism
Mattress: memory foam mattress
Filling: high-density foam, duck feathers, polyester fiber
Fabric: 100% olefin, Martindale test - 50,000 rubs

fabric.performance_claim: LifeGuard 100% olefin performance weave; blot damp, persistent spills dry clean only.
fabric.abrasion_test: Martindale rubs, NOT Wyzenbeek double rubs; no conversion made

article_leigh.care:
LifeGuard fabrics buy you time. Simply absorb spills by blotting with a damp cloth
For more persistant spills, LifeGuard requires dry clean only
Use of chemical cleaners is not advised
Fluff cushions regularly to help maintain shape
After mattress use, leave bed fully extended to air out before folding back into sofa
Some assembly required (approximately 10 minutes)

warranty.term: 5-year limited indoor upholstery warranty, effective August 17, 2026
warranty.scope: Year 1 defects; years 2–5 structural defects. No normal cushion softening, stains, pet damage; parts not guaranteed purchasable.
warranty.rental_eligibility: Not verified; do not assume residential warranty covers STR/MTR damage.

sleeper.sleep_assessment: Pull-out memory foam mattress; 70-inch adult length remains a limitation despite queen-width 60 inches. Loose reversible cushions, down blend; not overnight tested.
